_meta.name: FLUX 3 low-strength blend edit
_meta.purpose: Turn a composited insert (and optional product refs) into a photoreal overhead keyframe. Refer to connected stills as image 1, image 2, …

inputs.10.image: LoadImage filename of the composite / current keyframe
inputs.1.prompt: Edit instruction. Keep camera locked overhead.

inputs.prompt: Using image 1 as the locked overhead plate, nest the exact product from image 2 into the insert well so it looks physically present: correct contact shadows, slight tissue or paperboard tuck, matching light. Do not change camera, desk, box branding (there is none), or crop. Hands are not in this frame.
